summary: AC Immune SA filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing a press release dated August 20, 2026, reporting positive preliminary Phase 1 first-in-human data for its wholly-owned oral NLRP3 inflammasome inhibitor ACI-19764. The study showed safety and tolerability across SAD/MAD cohorts up to 20mg daily, confirmed CSF penetration, and dose-dependent IL-1beta inhibition; a Phase 1b cardiovascular risk cohort has begun dosing with initial hsCRP results expected by year end and full Phase 1/1b data in H1 2027. No deal terms, stake, price, board recommendation, or advisor are stated; the filing is a routine clinical milestone update, not a special situation.
